system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: instantiate N domain reviewers from the project gatekeeper core + a generated domain overlay
system_prompt_style.note: Reviewer prompts composed at runtime from core + generated overlay; host is Claude Code skill (SKILL.md auto-loaded).

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: `decompose`: split manuscript (LaTeX or Markdown) into reading units, the canonical section list, and stable `passage-id`s (which prevent text drift and give jurors local context).
env_context_strategy.note: Whole-paper reading injected to reviewers plus on-demand context expansion for jurors.

context_compaction.note: Context management delegated to host Claude Code; skill source (SKILL.md, workflows) not in bundle.

observation_format.evidence_quote: the semantic, no-human-in-the-middle steps run as Workflows (parallelism plus schema-validated output by construction)

tool_call_format.note: Tool calling is the host Claude Code's; not declared in the skill.

tool_count.note: Host tools; skill ships 12 scripts and 12 workflows, not model tool schemas.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: `apply-patch.js`: atomic apply plus journal of a drafted patch, and revert (exact-once guard on `before` text).
edit_primitive.note: Before/after text patch inferred as search_replace.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: The courtroom engine is `assign-reviewers → reading-check → coverage-auditor → merge → {trial ‖ polish} → recall-audit → drafter → {edit-audit | meaning-audit} → clerk`.
loop_primitives.note: Auto mode loops rounds until clerk convergence; jury majority voting.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: `LEDGER.json` resolved at runtime = the machine source of truth
planning_granularity.note: Ledger of issues across rounds serves as task list.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: a jury of 5 (escalating to 12 only when it cannot reach a clear majority) deliberates under isolation, and a judge returns one of three verdicts
multi_agent_topology.note: Also debate-like trial (defense vs jury + judge); in review mode.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: spawn the **same** N reviewers / jurors as **parallel `Agent`/`Task` subagents in a single message**

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: Never edit the manuscript without explicit author sign-off.
human_in_loop.note: Default per-edit sign-off; auto mode uses up-front spine/reviewer confirmation.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: JSON ledger plus MD view; **gate = `/goal` completion fact**

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: **Claude memory**: the active project's memory: stable conventions worth recalling next session (this paper's house style, venue, persona tuning).

state_persistence.evidence_quote: if a `.paper-review/` working copy AND a ledger exist, REUSE them, never re-extract
state_persistence.note: Ledger is live state across rounds and sessions.

self_verification.evidence_quote: `edit-audit` checks a risky non-anchor edit (make-sense + cross-section alignment); `meaning-audit` is the four-state frozen-anchor + arc audit.
self_verification.note: compile-guard runs LaTeX compile/structural lint on edits.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: `review` stops at the human gates and does not auto-advance.
retry_policy.note: Auto mode multi-round until gate passes (until_pass) reachable via /goal.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: Termination: clerk convergence (primary) OR applied-quiescence (K dry rounds) OR a hard limit.
termination_condition.note: Auto mode; gate pass = ledger.js gate.

cost_controls.note: Cost handled by host; fast mode only on TODO.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: The **deterministic guards in `scripts/`** run orchestrator-side via Bash between workflow calls.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: Your project files, ledger, journal, and patches stay inside your local paper project.
filesystem_access.note: Relative to host; original docx never modified.

network_policy.evidence_quote: the skill performs a soft update check against stable GitHub release tags

permission_model.evidence_quote: it drafts the change, self-checks it, shows you the patch, and applies it after you approve.
permission_model.note: For manuscript edits; auto mode uses pre-authorized bounded-aggressive policy (policy_engine).

replayability.note: No replay discussed; sources not opened.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: **Validation of the engine on real papers at scale.**
eval_hooks.note: Listed as roadmap; only dogfood sample.

guardrails.evidence_quote: Safe fixes land under risk-proportional safety (frozen anchors, a per-passage edit cap, an anchor and cross-section meaning audit)

target_domain.evidence_quote: A pre-submission AI review stress-test for research papers.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: It is a Claude Code skill, installable two ways.
